Ab_Crunch_Machine.name: Machine Crunch
steps: Set the seat so the handles or pads sit at your upper chest, then sit down and hook your feet under the rollers.
Hold the handles and brace your stomach.
Curl your chest down towards your hips by rounding your upper back, moving slowly.
Pause when your stomach is fully squeezed, then let the pad rise back slowly.
Move with your stomach muscles, not by pulling with your arms.

Ab_Roller.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel on the floor below your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and tuck your hips slightly so your lower back stays flat.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, letting your hips and chest lower together, as far as you can keep your back from sagging.
Pull the wheel back towards your knees using your stomach until you return to the start.
Shorten the distance you roll out if your lower back starts to arch.

Alternate_Hammer_Curl.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl, Alternating
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing your thighs.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder, palm still facing in.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
Repeat with the other arm, and keep alternating.
Keep your upper arms still and don't swing your body to lift the weight.

Alternating_Renegade_Row.name: Kettlebell Renegade Row
steps: Set two kettlebells on the floor about shoulder-width apart and hold the handles in a high plank, arms straight and feet wide.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line.
Row one kettlebell up to the side of your ribs, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it back to the floor with control, then row with the other arm.
Keep your hips level and facing the floor; widen your feet if they twist.

Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.name: Arnold Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you and elbows in front.
Press the dumbbells up while turning your palms to face forwards, finishing with your arms straight above your shoulders.
Lower them slowly, turning your palms back to face you as they return to the start.
Keep your back against the pad and don't arch your lower back to finish the press.

Ball_Leg_Curl.name: Ball Leg Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your arms on the floor at your sides and your heels on top of an exercise ball.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Pull the ball towards you by bending your knees, keeping your hips high.
Straighten your legs slowly to roll the ball back out.
Keep your hips up throughout; don't let them drop as the ball rolls away.

Band_Assisted_Pull-Up.name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
steps: Loop a resistance band around a pull-up bar and pull one end through the other so it's secure.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away, slightly wider than your shoulders, and put one knee or foot in the band.
Start from a hang with straight arms, then pull your chest up towards the bar until your chin is above it.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a lighter band as you get stronger, since the band takes less of your body weight.

Band_Pull_Apart.name: Band Pull-Apart
steps: Stand tall and hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides until it touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start, keeping tension on the band.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and your arms nearly straight.

Band_Skull_Crusher.name: Band Skull Crusher
steps: Anchor a resistance band low behind the head end of a flat bench, then lie on the bench holding the band ends.
Point your upper arms straight up with your elbows bent, so your hands are near your forehead.
Straighten your elbows to push your hands up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Bend your elbows slowly to return to the start.
Keep your upper arms still; only your forearms should move.

Barbell_Ab_Rollout_-_On_Knees.name: Barbell Rollout
steps: Put round plates of the same size on a barbell so it rolls, then kneel on a mat behind it.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, shoulders above the bar.
Brace your stomach and roll the bar forward slowly, lowering your chest and hips together.
Go as far as you can without your lower back sagging, then pull the bar back to your knees using your stomach.
Keep your hips slightly tucked and stop short if your back starts to arch.

Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders, squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift the bar off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest, keeping your elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight above your shoulders.
Keep your hips and shoulder blades on the bench, and use a spotter or safety arms when you train heavy.

Barbell_Curl.name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart and arms straight.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back or swing to lift the bar.

Barbell_Deadlift.name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight.
Flatten your back, brace your stomach and lift your chest so your shoulders are just in front of the bar.
Push the floor away with your legs and stand up tall, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back first, then bending your knees once it passes them. Keep your back flat throughout.

Barbell_Full_Squat.name: Barbell Back Squat, Full Depth
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height, step under it and place it across your upper back, below your neck.
Lift the bar out, step back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Brace your stomach, then bend your hips and knees together to squat as deep as you can with a flat back, hips below your knees.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your chest up; set the safety bars just below your lowest point.

Barbell_Glute_Bridge.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and roll a padded barbell over your legs until it sits in the crease of your hips.
Lie back, bend your knees and set your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart, holding the bar in place.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down and don't arch your lower back at the top.

Barbell_Hip_Thrust.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a bench and rest a padded barbell, or a dumbbell held with both hands, across your hips.
Bend your knees and set your feet flat, about hip-width apart, so your shins are upright at the top.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body is flat from shoulders to knees.
Pause, then lower your hips slowly towards the floor.
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down so the movement comes from your hips, not your lower back.

Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and lie back with your eyes under the racked bar and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack, arms straight.
Lower the bar slowly to your upper chest, just below your collarbones.
Press it back up until your arms are straight above your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together and your back on the bench throughout.

Barbell_Lunge.name: Barbell Lunge
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step forward with one leg.
Bend both knees to lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your chest up.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee in line with your toes and your upper body upright.

Barbell_Shoulder_Press.name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support in a rack and set the bar at about the height of your chin when seated.
Hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders, lift it off the rack and hold it just above your upper chest.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower it slowly back to the top of your chest.
Keep your back against the pad and your stomach braced; don't arch to push the bar up.

Barbell_Shrug.name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your arms straight and don't roll your shoulders; move straight up and down.

Barbell_Squat.name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and place it across your upper back, below your neck.
Lift the bar out, take a step or two back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Brace your stomach, then push your hips back and bend your knees to squat until your thighs are at least level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and your knees in line with your toes; set the safety bars just below your lowest point.

Barbell_Step_Ups.name: Barbell Step-Up
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height.
Put one whole foot on top of the box.
Push through that foot to step up until you're standing tall on the box, bringing your other foot up beside it.
Step down slowly with the foot you brought up last, then repeat.
Drive with the leg on the box and avoid pushing off with the foot on the floor.

Barbell_Walking_Lunge.name: Barbell Walking Lunge
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, in a clear space.
Take a long step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand and bring your back foot forward into the next step.
Keep alternating legs as you walk forward.
Keep your chest up and your front knee in line with your toes.

Bench_Dips.name: Bench Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers over the edge.
Straighten your arms and move your hips forward off the bench, legs out in front with heels on the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips towards the floor until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms again.
Keep your back close to the bench and your elbows pointing behind you, not out to the sides.

Bench_Press_-_With_Bands.name: Band Bench Press
steps: Loop a resistance band around each end of a barbell and anchor the bands to the bench frame or to the floor below it.
Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor, and hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift the bar off the rack and lower it slowly to the middle of your chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight; the bands pull harder as the bar rises.
Control the bar on the way down so the bands don't pull it into your chest, and use a spotter.

Bent-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell above your chest with both hands cupping one end.
Bend your elbows clearly, more than for a straight-arm pullover, and keep that bend throughout.
Lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch in your chest and under your arms.
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your hips on the bench and don't lower further than your shoulders are comfortable with.

Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
steps: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders, standing with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back to lean forward until your upper body is close to level with the floor, arms straight.
Pull the bar to your lower chest or upper stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat and your upper body still; don't stand up to move the bar.

Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in, and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back to lean forward, back flat and arms hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbells up to the sides of your stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower the dumbbells slowly.
Keep your back flat and your neck in line with it throughout.

Bodyweight_Calf_Raise.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step, or flat on the floor, and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you comfortably can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Keep your knees straight but not locked, and don't bounce at the bottom.

Bodyweight_Squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly and arms in front of you for balance.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower yourself as far as you comfortably can, ideally until your thighs are level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your chest up, your heels on the floor and your knees in line with your toes.

Bodyweight_Walking_Lunge.name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, in a space where you can walk forward.
Take a long step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor, bending both knees.
Push through your front foot and bring your back foot forward into the next step.
Keep alternating legs as you walk.
Keep your upper body upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

Box_Squat.name: Box Squat
steps: Place a box or bench behind you at a height where your thighs are about level with the floor when you sit on it.
Set a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand in front of the box, feet a little wider than shoulder-width.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to sit down onto the box under control.
Pause briefly while keeping your stomach braced, then push through your feet to stand up.
Sit lightly on the box rather than dropping onto it, and keep your back flat.

Butt_Lift_Bridge.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart and arms by your sides.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back doesn't arch at the top.

Butterfly.name: Machine Chest Fly
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles or place your forearms on the pads with your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest, squeezing your chest muscles.
Let your arms open back slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad and the bend in your elbows the same throughout.

Cable_Chest_Press.name: Cable Chest Press
steps: Set two pulleys at about chest height, hold a handle in each hand and step forward so the cables are taut, one foot ahead of the other.
Bring your hands beside your chest with your elbows bent and slightly below shoulder height.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight in front of your chest.
Let your hands come back slowly to the sides of your chest.
Keep your stomach braced so your body doesn't sway as you press.

Cable_Crossover.name: Cable Crossover
steps: Set both pulleys high, hold a handle in each hand and step forward to the middle, one foot ahead of the other.
Lean forward slightly with your arms out to the sides and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands down and together in front of your lower chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest, then let your arms return slowly along the same arc until you feel a stretch.
Keep the bend in your elbows the same throughout; it's a hugging movement, not a press.

Cable_Crunch.name: Cable Crunch
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine, holding the rope ends beside your head.
Bend at the hips slightly so the cable is taut, with your back straight.
Curl your chest down towards your knees by rounding your upper back and squeezing your stomach.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your hips still; the movement comes from your stomach, not from sitting back.

Cable_Hammer_Curls_-_Rope_Attachment.name: Cable Hammer Curl
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end in each hand, palms facing each other.
Stand tall facing the machine with your arms straight and your elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up towards your shoulders, keeping your palms facing each other.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back to lift the weight.

Cable_One_Arm_Tricep_Extension.name: One-Arm Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and hold it with one hand, palm facing down.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked against your side, forearm about level with the floor.
Straighten your arm to push the handle down until your arm is fully straight.
Let your forearm rise slowly back to the start, then switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper arm still at your side; only your forearm should move.

Cable_Preacher_Curl.name: Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a straight bar attached.
Sit with the backs of your upper arms on the pad and hold the bar with an underhand grip, arms nearly straight.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, squeezing your biceps.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms on the pad throughout and don't let the weight pull your arms straight quickly.

Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set two pulleys at about shoulder height and stand in the middle.
Cross your arms in front of you and take the left cable in your right hand and the right cable in your left hand.
With your arms nearly straight, pull your hands out and back to the sides until they're in line with your shoulders.
Return slowly until your arms cross in front of you again.
Keep your shoulders down and your elbows slightly bent; don't lean back to move the weight.

Cable_Seated_Lateral_Raise.name: Seated Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Sit on a bench side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the hand farther from the machine, so the cable crosses your body.
Sit tall with your arm slightly bent and your hand in front of your hip.
Raise your arm out to the side until your hand is at shoulder height.
Lower it slowly back across your body, then switch arms after the set.
Lead with your elbow and don't lift your shoulder towards your ear.

Cable_Shoulder_Press.name: Cable Shoulder Press
steps: Place a bench with back support between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Sit with your back against the pad and bring the handles to your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
Keep your back against the pad and your stomach braced; don't arch your lower back.

Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Sit in the leg press and place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, hip-width apart, with your heels off it.
Press the platform up until your legs are straight but not locked, and release the safety handles.
Push through the balls of your feet to point your toes and move the platform away.
Lower the platform slowly by letting your heels come back towards you until your calves stretch.
Keep your knees straight throughout and keep your feet firmly on the platform.

Chin-Up.name: Chin-Up
steps: Hold a pull-up bar with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and your stomach braced.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar, bringing your elbows down towards your ribs.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
Avoid swinging or kicking your legs to get up.

Clean_and_Press.name: Clean and Press
steps: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, grip it just outside your legs and set a flat back with your hips above your knees.
Lift the bar by pushing through your legs, then jump it up fast, shrugging and pulling your elbows up.
Drop under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows forward, then stand up.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are straight overhead, moving your head back out of its path.
Lower the bar to your shoulders, then to your thighs and the floor, keeping your back flat.

Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.name: Barbell Bench Press, Close Grip
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, a little narrower than for a normal bench press.
Lift the bar off the rack and lower it slowly to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Don't bring your hands too close together; keep your wrists straight above your elbows.

Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown, Close Grip
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away and your hands a little narrower than shoulder-width.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing your body to pull the bar down.

Concentration_Curls.name: Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Press the back of that upper arm against the inside of your thigh, arm straight and palm facing up.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm against your thigh.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it slowly until your arm is straight, and switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper body still and let only your forearm move.

Crunches.name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands lightly beside your head or cross them on your chest.
Squeeze your stomach to lift your shoulders off the floor, curling your ribs towards your hips.
Pause briefly, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Don't pull on your head; keep a small gap between your chin and your chest.

Dead_Bug.name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with your arms pointing straight up and your knees bent above your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your stomach.
Slowly lower one arm behind your head and straighten the opposite leg towards the floor, without touching it.
Bring them back to the start and repeat with the other arm and leg.
Keep your lower back on the floor throughout; don't lower as far if it starts to lift.

Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured under the pads and your eyes under the racked bar.
Hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack, with a spotter if you can.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together and the bar moving under control.

Decline_Crunch.name: Decline Crunch
steps: Lie back on a decline bench with your knees bent and your feet hooked under the pads.
Cross your arms on your chest, hold a weight plate against it, or place your hands lightly beside your head.
Squeeze your stomach to curl your shoulders off the bench, ribs towards your hips. For a sit-up, keep curling until your chest is near your thighs.
Lower yourself slowly back to the bench without dropping.
Don't pull on your head; keep a small gap between your chin and your chest.

Decline_Dumbbell_Bench_Press.name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand on your thighs.
Bring the dumbbells to the sides of your chest as you lie back, then press them up above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your lower chest.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists straight and the dumbbells above your elbows.

Dip_Machine.name: Machine Dip
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are about level with your hips when your arms are bent, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with your elbows bent and pointing back.
Push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles rise slowly until your elbows are bent again.
Keep your shoulders down and your back against the pad.

Dips_-_Chest_Version.name: Chest Dip
steps: Hold the parallel bars and lift yourself up with straight arms.
Lean your upper body forward and bend your knees, crossing your ankles behind you.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself until you feel a stretch in your chest, letting your elbows flare slightly.
Push back up until your arms are straight, keeping the forward lean.
Stop lowering when your shoulders feel strained; you don't need to go very deep.

Dips_-_Triceps_Version.name: Triceps Dip
steps: Hold the parallel bars and lift yourself up with straight arms.
Keep your upper body upright and your elbows close to your sides.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and move slowly at the bottom.

Dumbbell_Alternate_Bicep_Curl.name: Dumbbell Curl, Alternating
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing your thighs.
Curl one dumbbell up, turning your palm to face up as it rises towards your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it slowly, turning your palm back in.
Repeat with the other arm, and keep alternating.
Keep your elbows by your sides and don't swing your body.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Sit on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh, then lie back, bringing them to the sides of your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your chest, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Press them back up, bringing them close together at the top.
Keep your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled together on the bench.

Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl.name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl both dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back or swing to lift the weight.

Dumbbell_Floor_Press.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your upper arms touch the floor, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Pause briefly with your arms on the floor, without relaxing.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are straight.
Let your arms touch the floor lightly instead of dropping onto it.

Dumbbell_Flyes.name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest along the same arc.
Don't lower the dumbbells below the level of your shoulders.

Dumbbell_Incline_Row.name: Incline Dumbbell Row
steps: Set an incline bench to a low angle and lie face down on it, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight.
Keep your chest on the pad and your feet on the floor.
Pull the dumbbells up to the sides of your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the bench throughout; don't lift it to help the weight up.

Dumbbell_Lunges.name: Dumbbell Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step forward with one leg and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push through your front foot to step back to the start, then repeat with the other leg.
For walking lunges, bring your back foot forward into the next step instead of stepping back.
Keep your upper body upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step back with one leg and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push through your front foot to bring your back foot forward to the start.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep most of your weight on your front foot and your upper body upright.

Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward and elbows below your wrists.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Don't lean back or arch your lower back to push the weight up.

Dumbbell_Shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your arms straight and move straight up and down without rolling your shoulders.

Dumbbell_Side_Bend.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in one hand at your side, other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways towards the dumbbell, letting it slide down your leg.
Use the opposite side of your waist to pull yourself back up to standing.
Finish the set, then switch sides.
Bend only to the side; don't lean forward or back.

Dumbbell_Squat.name: Dumbbell Squat
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your chest up, your heels down and your knees in line with your toes.

Dumbbell_Step_Ups.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height, with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Place one whole foot on the box.
Push through that foot to step up until you're standing tall on the box, bringing your other foot up beside it.
Step down slowly with the foot you brought up last, then repeat.
Drive with the leg on the box and avoid pushing off with the foot on the floor.

EZ-Bar_Curl.name: EZ-Bar Curl
steps: Stand tall holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the angled parts, arms straight.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back or swing.

EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar above your chest with an overhand grip on the inner angled parts.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead.
Stop just above your forehead, then straighten your arms to press the bar back up.
Keep your elbows pointing up and in, not out to the sides.
Move slowly near your head, and use a weight you can control.

Elevated_Cable_Rows.name: Elevated Cable Row
steps: Place a low platform or step on the seat of a low-pulley row station and sit on it, feet braced and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with straight arms, letting your shoulders reach forward for a stretch.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let it return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back straight and your upper body still; don't rock back to move the weight.

External_Rotation_with_Cable.name: Cable External Rotation
steps: Set a pulley at about elbow height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle in the hand farther from the machine.
Keep that elbow bent at a right angle and tucked against your side, forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm out, away from your body, as far as you comfortably can while keeping your elbow at your side.
Return slowly to the start, then switch sides after the set.
Use a light weight and move slowly; your upper arm shouldn't move.

Face_Pull.name: Face Pull
steps: Attach a rope to a pulley set at about face height and hold the ends with your palms facing in.
Step back until your arms are straight and the cable is taut, standing tall.
Pull the rope towards your face, separating the ends and bringing your elbows out and back, level with your shoulders.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and don't lean back to pull.

Farmers_Walk.name: Farmer's Walk
steps: Place a heavy dumbbell, kettlebell or farmer's handle beside each foot.
Squat down with a flat back, grip the handles firmly and stand up tall.
Walk forward with short, steady steps, arms straight at your sides.
Stop after the distance or time you've set and set the weights down by squatting, not bending your back.
Keep your shoulders back and your stomach braced; don't let the weights swing.

Flat_Bench_Lying_Leg_Raise.name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back on a flat bench and hold the sides of the bench behind your head.
Straighten your legs out in line with the bench, with your knees slightly soft.
Raise your legs until they point straight up, keeping them together.
Lower them slowly until they're level with the bench, without letting them drop.
Keep your lower back pressed into the bench; bend your knees more if it lifts.

Front_Barbell_Squat.name: Barbell Front Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and step under it so it sits on the front of your shoulders, close to your throat.
Hold the bar with your fingertips just outside your shoulders and lift your elbows high, upper arms about level with the floor.
Step back, stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and squat down, keeping your chest up and elbows high.
Go until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then push through your whole foot to stand up.
Keep your elbows up throughout so the bar stays on your shoulders; if they drop, the bar rolls forward.

Front_Dumbbell_Raise.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
With your arms nearly straight, raise one or both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to your thighs.
Keep your upper body still and don't swing the weights up.

Front_Squats_With_Two_Kettlebells.name: Double Kettlebell Front Squat
steps: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your shoulders, handles in your palms and the bells against your forearms, elbows tucked in.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat as deep as you can with your chest up.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your elbows close to your body and your back straight throughout.

Glute_Ham_Raise.name: Glute Ham Raise
steps: Adjust the glute ham bench so your knees are just behind the pad and your feet are secured against the foot plate.
Start with your body upright on your knees, straight from knees to head.
Lower your upper body forward slowly by straightening your knees, keeping your hips straight.
Pull yourself back up by pressing your toes into the plate and bending your knees.
Keep your glutes squeezed so your hips don't bend; use your hands to help at first if needed.

Goblet_Squat.name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the handle, or a dumbbell by one end, close to your chest with your elbows pointing down.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Squat down between your legs, keeping your chest up, until your elbows are near the inside of your knees.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep the weight close to your chest and your heels on the floor.

Good_Morning.name: Good Morning
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Brace your stomach and keep your back flat.
Push your hips back to lean forward until your upper body is nearly level with the floor, or until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your upper body back to standing.
Keep your back flat throughout and start with a light weight.

Hack_Squat.name: Hack Squat
steps: Stand on the hack squat platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform and release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower yourself until your thighs are about level with the platform.
Push through your whole foot to straighten your legs, stopping just short of locking your knees.
Keep your back against the pad and your knees in line with your toes.

Hammer_Curls.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl both dumbbells up, palms still facing in.
Squeeze at the top, then lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't swing your body.

Hammer_Grip_Incline_DB_Bench_Press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press, Neutral Grip
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with your palms facing each other.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your palms facing each other and your shoulder blades against the bench throughout.

Handstand_Push-Ups.name: Handstand Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders, about a hand's length from a wall.
Kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall and your arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your head slowly towards the floor, with your head slightly in front of your hands.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Only try this once you can hold a handstand against a wall comfortably; put a folded mat under your head.

Hang_Clean.name: Hang Clean
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip just outside your legs.
Push your hips back and bend your knees slightly so the bar lowers to just above your knees, back flat.
Jump the bar up fast by straightening your hips and knees, shrugging and pulling your elbows up.
Drop under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows forward, then stand up.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout, and learn the lift with a light bar first.

Hanging_Leg_Raise.name: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart and your legs straight.
Brace your stomach and keep your body still.
Raise your legs until your thighs are at least level with the floor, bending your knees if you need to.
Lower them slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging; pause at the bottom if you start to sway.

Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions.name: Back Extension
steps: Set the back extension bench so the top of the pad sits just below your hips, then lock your heels under the foot pads.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper body hang down, back straight.
Raise your upper body until it's in line with your legs.
Lower it slowly back down.
Stop when your body is straight; don't arch your back beyond that.

Incline_Bench_Pull.name: Incline Barbell Row
steps: Set an incline bench to a low angle and lie face down on it with a barbell on the floor below you.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms hanging straight.
Pull the bar up towards the bench, bringing your elbows up and back.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the bench throughout.

Incline_Cable_Flye.name: Incline Cable Fly
steps: Place an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand as you lie back.
Start with your arms above your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring your hands back together above your chest along the same arc.
Keep the bend in your elbows the same throughout.

Incline_Dumbbell_Curl.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Turn your palms to face forward.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders without moving your upper arms forward.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight again.
Keep your back and head against the bench throughout.

Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest along the same arc.
Don't lower the dumbbells below the level of your shoulders.

Incline_Dumbbell_Press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and sit with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Lie back, bringing the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, then press them up above your upper chest.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your upper chest, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet flat and your back and shoulder blades against the bench.

Incline_Push-Up.name: Incline Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on a bench, box or sturdy raised surface, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge of the surface.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your stomach and glutes tight so your hips don't sag.

Inverted_Row.name: Inverted Row
steps: Set a bar in a rack or Smith machine at about waist height and lie underneath it.
Hold the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders, arms straight and heels on the floor.
Keep your body straight from head to heels and pull your chest up to the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up; bend your knees to make it easier or raise the bar.

JM_Press.name: JM Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows and let the bar come down and slightly towards your head, keeping your elbows pointing towards your feet.
Lower it until the bar is just above your upper chest or chin, with your forearms nearly upright.
Push the bar back up by straightening your elbows.
Use a moderate weight and move slowly; it's a mix of a close-grip bench press and a skullcrusher.

Kettlebell_One-Legged_Deadlift.name: Kettlebell Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding a kettlebell in the hand opposite your standing leg.
Push your hips back and lean forward, letting your free leg rise straight behind you.
Lower the kettlebell towards the floor until your upper body is nearly level with the floor, or as far as your balance allows.
Squeeze the glute of your standing leg to return to standing.
Keep your hips level and your back flat throughout.

Kettlebell_Thruster.name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows tucked in, and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about level with the floor, keeping your chest up.
Push up out of the squat and use that drive to press the kettlebells overhead in one movement.
Lower the kettlebells back to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.
Keep your elbows up in the squat and your stomach braced during the press.

Kettlebell_Turkish_Get-Up_Squat_style.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
steps: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight above one shoulder, with the knee on that side bent and the foot flat.
Roll onto the opposite elbow and then that hand, keeping the kettlebell straight above you.
Lift your hips, bring both feet under you into a deep squat, then stand up with the kettlebell overhead.
Reverse each step slowly to return to lying on the floor, then switch sides.
Keep your arm straight and your eyes on the kettlebell until you're standing.

Kettlebell_Windmill.name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Hold a kettlebell straight above one shoulder and stand with your feet wider than your hips, both toes turned away from the kettlebell side.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and push your hips out towards the side holding it.
Lean down towards your other foot, sliding your free hand down that leg, until your upper body is close to level with the floor.
Rise back up the same way, keeping the kettlebell arm straight, then switch sides after the set.
Keep both legs nearly straight and move slowly.

Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars.name: Parallel Bar Knee Raise
steps: Hold yourself up on parallel bars or a leg raise station with your arms straight or forearms on the pads, legs hanging.
Brace your stomach and keep your back against the pad if there is one.
Bend your knees and raise them towards your chest, curling your hips up slightly.
Lower your legs slowly until they're straight again.
Avoid swinging your legs to get them up.

Lateral_Raise_-_With_Bands.name: Band Lateral Raise
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with your feet hip-width apart and hold one end in each hand at your sides.
With your elbows slightly bent, raise your arms out to the sides until your hands are at shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower them slowly.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.

Leg_Extensions.name: Leg Extension
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot point and the pad sits on your lower shins.
Sit back against the pad and hold the handles at your sides.
Straighten your legs to lift the pad until your knees are straight.
Pause briefly, then lower the pad slowly.
Keep your hips on the seat and don't kick the weight up.

Leg_Press.name: Leg Press
steps: Sit in the leg press with your back against the pad and your feet about shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Press the platform up until your legs are nearly straight, then release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly until your knees are at about a right angle.
Push through your whole foot to press the platform back up, stopping just short of locking your knees.
Keep your lower back and hips against the pad; don't lower so far that your hips lift.

Leverage_Chest_Press.name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at the middle of your chest, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with your elbows bent and slightly below your shoulders.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Let them come back slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your back and shoulder blades against the pad.

Leverage_High_Row.name: Machine High Row
steps: Adjust the seat so you can just reach the handles with straight arms, then sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles, which are above and in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back towards your chest, bringing your elbows down past your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest against the pad and don't lean back to pull.

Leverage_Iso_Row.name: Machine Row
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at about chest height, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles with your arms straight.
Pull the handles back towards your ribs, one at a time or together, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest against the pad throughout.

Low_Cable_Crossover.name: Low Cable Crossover
steps: Set both pulleys low, hold a handle in each hand and step forward to the middle, one foot ahead of the other.
Start with your arms down and out to the sides, elbows slightly bent and palms facing forward.
Raise your hands up and together in front of your upper chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest, then let your arms return slowly along the same arc.
Keep the bend in your elbows the same and your upper body still.

Lying_Dumbbell_Tricep_Extension.name: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Stop when your forearms are just past level with the bench, then straighten your arms to lift them back up.
Keep your elbows pointing up and in, not out to the sides.
Move slowly near your head, and use a weight you can control.

Lying_Leg_Curls.name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot point, then lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed into the bench.
Curl your heels towards your glutes as far as you can.
Pause briefly, then lower the pad slowly until your legs are straight.
Keep your hips down; if they lift, use a lighter weight.

Machine_Bench_Press.name: Machine Bench Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest, then lie or sit back against the pad.
Hold the handles slightly wider than your shoulders with your elbows bent.
Press the handles away from you until your arms are straight.
Let them return slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your back and shoulder blades against the pad throughout.

Machine_Bicep_Curl.name: Machine Biceps Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so your upper arms lie flat on the pad and your elbows line up with the machine's pivot point.
Hold the handles with an underhand grip, arms nearly straight.
Curl the handles up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps, then lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and don't lift your body off the seat.

Machine_Shoulder_Military_Press.name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at about shoulder height, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with your palms facing forward.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad and don't arch your lower back.

Machine_Triceps_Extension.name: Machine Triceps Extension
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot point and your upper arms lie on the pad.
Hold the handles with your elbows bent.
Straighten your arms to push the handles down or forward until your elbows are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows are bent again.
Keep your upper arms on the pad; only your forearms should move.

Monster_Walk.name: Monster Walk
steps: Place a resistance band around your legs, just above your knees or around your ankles.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart so the band is taut, then bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step forward and out to the side with one foot, then with the other, walking forward in a wide stance.
Walk for the distance you've set, then walk backwards the same way.
Keep tension on the band throughout and don't let your knees fall inwards.

Mountain_Climbers.name: Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Bring one knee towards your chest.
Switch legs quickly, sending that foot back as you bring the other knee in.
Keep switching at a steady pace for the time you've set.
Keep your hips low and your shoulders above your hands.

Narrow_Stance_Leg_Press.name: Leg Press, Narrow Stance
steps: Sit in the leg press and place your feet close together, less than hip-width apart, in the middle of the platform.
Press the platform up and release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly as far as you can while keeping your hips on the pad.
Push through your whole foot to press the platform back up, stopping just short of locking your knees.
Keep your knees pointing the same way as your toes.

One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place one knee and the same hand on a flat bench, with the other foot on the floor and your back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand with your arm hanging straight down.
Pull the dumbbell up to the side of your ribs, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your back flat and your shoulders level; don't twist to lift the weight.

One-Arm_Kettlebell_Row.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row
steps: Place a kettlebell on the floor and stand in a staggered stance, one hand on your front thigh or a bench.
Lean forward with your back flat and hold the kettlebell in your other hand, arm straight.
Pull the kettlebell up to the side of your ribs, elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your shoulders level and don't twist your upper body.

One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and a kettlebell on the floor just in front of you.
Push your hips back, grab the handle with one hand and swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward sharply to swing the kettlebell up to about chest height, arm straight.
Let it swing back down between your legs as you push your hips back, then repeat, switching hands after the set.
The power comes from your hips, not your arm; keep your back flat.

One-Legged_Cable_Kickback.name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and fasten it around one ankle.
Face the machine, hold it for support and lean forward slightly.
Kick the strapped leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Return it slowly to the start, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your back flat and don't swing the leg higher by arching your lower back.

One_Arm_Lat_Pulldown.name: One-Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and sit or kneel facing the machine.
Hold the handle with one hand, arm straight above you.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, bringing your elbow down towards your hip.
Let it rise slowly until your arm is straight, then switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper body still and don't twist to pull the handle.

Overhead_Cable_Curl.name: Overhead Cable Curl
steps: Set two pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding a handle in each hand with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your palms to face up.
Curl the handles in towards the sides of your head, keeping your upper arms level with the floor.
Squeeze your biceps, then straighten your arms slowly.
Keep your upper arms still; only your forearms should move.

Pallof_Press.name: Pallof Press
steps: Set a pulley at about chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with both hands at the middle of your chest.
Step away until the cable is taut and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Press the handle straight out in front of you until your arms are straight, resisting the pull to rotate.
Hold briefly, then bring the handle back to your chest, and switch sides after the set.
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward throughout.

Palms-Down_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a flat bench and place your forearms on it, hands hanging over the edge.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing down, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar by bending your wrists upwards as far as you can.
Lower it slowly as far as is comfortable.
Keep your forearms on the bench; only your hands should move.

Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a flat bench and place your forearms on it, hands hanging over the edge.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing up, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let the bar lower slowly by bending your wrists down.
Curl your wrists up to lift the bar as high as you can.
Keep your forearms on the bench; only your hands should move.

Plank.name: Plank
steps: Place your forearms on the floor with your elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position for the time you've set, breathing steadily.
Don't let your hips sag or lift; stop when you can't keep the line.

Power_Clean.name: Power Clean
steps: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, grip it just outside your legs and set a flat back with your hips above your knees.
Push through your legs to lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Jump the bar up fast by straightening your hips and knees, shrugging and pulling your elbows up.
Drop slightly under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows forward, then stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout, and learn the lift with a light bar first.

Preacher_Curl.name: Barbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, arms nearly straight.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, squeezing your biceps.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and control the bar at the bottom.

Pull_Through.name: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut, feet a little wider than your hips.
Push your hips back and let the rope pull your hands between your legs, knees slightly bent and back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips forward and stand up tall.
Your arms only hold the rope; the movement comes from your hips.

Pullups.name: Pull-Up
steps: Hold a pull-up bar with your palms facing away, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms straight and your stomach braced.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar, bringing your elbows down towards your ribs.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
Avoid swinging or kicking your legs to get up.

Push-Ups_-_Close_Triceps_Position.name: Push-Up, Close Grip
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands close together under your chest.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards your hands, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line with your body; do them on your knees if you can't keep it straight.

Push-Ups_With_Feet_Elevated.name: Decline Push-Up
steps: Place your feet on a bench or box behind you and your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your stomach tight so your hips don't sag.

Push_Press.name: Push Press
steps: Hold a barbell on the front of your shoulders with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly, keeping your upper body upright.
Drive up with your legs and use that push to press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, bending your knees slightly to soften the landing.
Move your head back to let the bar pass, then bring it forward under the bar at the top.

Pushups.name: Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders and step your feet back into a high plank.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line; do them on your knees or against a bench if you can't keep it straight.

Reverse_Barbell_Curl.name: Barbell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists straight and your upper arms still.

Reverse_Crunch.name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your arms on the floor at your sides and your knees bent above your hips.
Squeeze your stomach to curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
Move slowly and don't swing your legs to lift your hips.

Reverse_Flyes.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward from your hips with your knees slightly bent, back flat and arms hanging below your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they're in line with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly back down.
Keep your upper body still and lead the movement with your elbows.

Reverse_Grip_Bent-Over_Rows.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row, Underhand
steps: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, back flat and arms straight.
Pull the bar to your lower stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat and don't stand up to move the bar.

Reverse_Grip_Triceps_Pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown, Underhand
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and hold it with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Stand tall facing the machine with your elbows tucked against your sides.
Straighten your arms to push the bar down to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about level with the floor.
Keep your elbows still at your sides and use a lighter weight than for the overhand version.

Reverse_Hyperextension.name: Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down on the reverse hyperextension machine with your hips at the edge of the pad and hold the handles.
Hook your ankles under the roller or strap, legs hanging down.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they're in line with your body.
Lower them slowly back down without letting them swing.
Keep your upper body on the pad and stop when your body is straight.

Reverse_Machine_Flyes.name: Machine Reverse Fly
steps: Sit facing the pad of a pec deck machine and set the handles to their rear position.
Hold the handles with your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Open your arms out to the sides until they're in line with your shoulders.
Let them return slowly to the front.
Keep your chest against the pad and your shoulders down.

Romanian_Deadlift.name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep them at that angle.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, usually just below your knees.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Keep your back flat and the bar close to your legs throughout.

Russian_Twist.name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels on the floor, or lifted for more challenge.
Lean back until you feel your stomach working, back straight, and hold your hands together in front of your chest.
Turn your upper body to one side, bringing your hands beside your hip.
Turn to the other side, and keep alternating.
Turn from your ribs, not just your arms, and keep your back straight.

Seated_Bent-Over_Rear_Delt_Raise.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly, Seated
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward until your chest is close to your thighs.
Let the dumbbells hang behind your calves, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are in line with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly back down.
Keep your chest down and don't swing the weights up.

Seated_Cable_Rows.name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit at a low-pulley row station with your feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, holding the handle with both hands.
Sit tall with your arms straight.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together and keeping your elbows close to your body.
Let it return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back straight and your upper body upright; don't rock back to pull.

Seated_Calf_Raise.name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit on the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pads on your lower thighs.
Lift the pads slightly and release the safety lever.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can for a stretch.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Move slowly through the whole range; don't bounce at the bottom.

Seated_Dumbbell_Press.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with an upright back and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your stomach and keep your back against the pad.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Don't arch your lower back to push the weight up.

Seated_Dumbbell_Shrug.name: Seated Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Sit upright on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your arms straight and your back upright; move straight up and down without rolling your shoulders.

Seated_Leg_Curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot point, and sit with the lower pad just above your heels.
Lower the thigh pad onto your legs so they're held in place, then hold the handles.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Let the pad return slowly until your legs are nearly straight.
Keep your back against the pad and move slowly.

Seated_Side_Lateral_Raise.name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands are at shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to your sides.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.

Shoulder_Press_-_With_Bands.name: Band Shoulder Press
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with your feet hip-width apart and hold one end in each hand at your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and stand tall.
Press your hands up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
Don't lean back or arch your lower back as you press.

Side_Bridge.name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your legs straight, one foot on top of the other.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the position for the time you've set, breathing steadily.
Lower your hips, then switch sides.
Keep your hips up and in line; don't let them drop or rotate.

Side_Lateral_Raise.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands are at shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to your sides.
Lead with your elbows, don't swing, and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.

Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor and arms by your sides.
Straighten one leg so it's in line with your other thigh.
Push through the heel on the floor to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee.
Lower your hips slowly, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your hips level; don't let the side of the raised leg drop.

Sissy_Squat.name: Sissy Squat
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a post or rail beside you for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, then bend your knees and push them forward while leaning your upper body back, keeping a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in the front of your thighs, then push through the balls of your feet to stand back up.
Keep your hips straight throughout; the movement comes from the knees, not from bending at the waist.

Sit-Up.name: Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, anchored under something if needed.
Cross your arms on your chest or place your hands lightly beside your head.
Curl your upper body up until your chest is close to your knees.
Lower yourself slowly back down.
Don't pull on your head or neck to get up.

Smith_Machine_Bench_Press.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Place a flat bench under the Smith machine so the bar lines up with the middle of your chest.
Lie back, hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and turn it to release it from the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight, and turn it to hook it back when you finish.
Set the safety stops just above your chest before you start.

Smith_Machine_Calf_Raise.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Place a step or plate under the Smith machine bar and set the bar at about shoulder height.
Step under it with the bar across your upper back and the balls of your feet on the step.
Straighten your legs, release the bar and lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Keep your knees straight but not locked, and don't bounce at the bottom.

Smith_Machine_Overhead_Shoulder_Press.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Place a bench with an upright back under the Smith machine so the bar comes down just in front of your face.
Sit down, hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and turn it to release it from the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly to about chin height.
Press it back up until your arms are straight, then turn it to hook it back when you finish.
Keep your back against the pad and your stomach braced.

Smith_Machine_Squat.name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height and step under it so it sits across your upper back.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of the bar, then turn the bar to release it.
Bend your knees and hips to squat until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Set the safety stops just below your lowest point, and keep your knees in line with your toes.

Smith_Single-Leg_Split_Squat.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height and step under it so it sits across your upper back.
Take a long step forward with one foot and keep the other behind you on its toes, then release the bar.
Bend both knees to lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping most of your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to rise back up, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your upper body upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

Spider_Curl.name: Spider Curl
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest near the top, holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight down in front of the bench.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze your biceps, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the bench and don't swing the bar.

Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and take a long step forward with one foot.
Lift the heel of your back foot so you're on the ball of that foot.
Bend both knees to lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your upper body upright.
Push through your front foot to rise back up, keeping your feet in place, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your front knee in line with your toes.

Standing_Barbell_Calf_Raise.name: Barbell Calf Raise
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand with the balls of your feet on a sturdy plate or step.
Stand tall with your knees straight but not locked.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Move slowly and keep your balance; start without the step if you feel unsteady.

Standing_Barbell_Press_Behind_Neck.name: Barbell Behind-the-Neck Press
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and hold it with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Step under the bar so it rests across your upper back, lift it out and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Press the bar straight up from behind your head until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower it slowly behind your head until it's at about ear level.
Keep your head still and facing forward, and only lower the bar as far as your shoulders move comfortably.

Standing_Biceps_Cable_Curl.name: Cable Curl
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall facing the machine with your arms straight and your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back.

Standing_Cable_Wood_Chop.name: Cable Woodchop
steps: Set a pulley high and stand side-on to it, feet about shoulder-width apart, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with your arms straight and your hands up towards the pulley, turned towards it.
Pull the handle down and across your body towards the opposite knee, turning your upper body and pivoting your back foot.
Return slowly to the start, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your arms nearly straight and turn from your stomach, not only your arms.

Standing_Calf_Raises.name: Machine Calf Raise
steps: Stand on the machine with your shoulders under the pads and the balls of your feet on the edge of the step.
Straighten your legs to lift the weight, knees straight but not locked.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Keep your knees straight and don't bounce at the bottom.

Standing_Dumbbell_Calf_Raise.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or plate, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall with your knees straight but not locked.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Hold one dumbbell and a support with your other hand if you need help balancing.

Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell with both hands under the top plate, arms straight above your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Lower it until you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Straighten your arms to lift the dumbbell back above your head.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your stomach braced so your lower back doesn't arch.

Standing_Dumbbell_Upright_Row.name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Lift the dumbbells up along the front of your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows are at about shoulder height and the dumbbells are at your lower chest.
Lower them slowly back to your thighs.
Keep the dumbbells close to your body and stop lower if your shoulders feel pinched.

Standing_Leg_Curl.name: Standing Leg Curl
steps: Stand at the machine with the pad behind the ankle of one leg and your knee lined up with the pivot point.
Hold the handles and keep your standing leg slightly bent.
Curl your heel up towards your glute as far as you can.
Lower it slowly until your leg is straight, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your hips and upper body still.

Standing_Low-Pulley_Deltoid_Raise.name: Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the hand farther from the machine, so the cable crosses in front of you.
Hold the machine with your other hand and keep your elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out to the side until your hand is at shoulder height.
Lower it slowly back across your body, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your upper body still and don't lean away to lift the weight.

Standing_Military_Press.name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and hold it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift it out so it sits on the front of your shoulders, and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back to let it pass, until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach so you don't lean back.

Standing_Overhead_Barbell_Triceps_Extens.name: Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall and hold a barbell above your head with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
