Lower it until you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Straighten your arms to press the bar back up.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your stomach braced.

Stiff-Legged_Barbell_Deadlift.name: Barbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees nearly straight, with only a slight bend.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs as far as you can with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Keep your back flat throughout; stop lowering when it starts to round.

Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift.name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep them at that angle.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Keep your back flat and the dumbbells close to your legs throughout.

Straight-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover.name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell above your chest with both hands cupping one end.
Keep your arms nearly straight, with only a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch in your chest and under your arms.
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your hips on the bench and don't lower further than your shoulders are comfortable with.

Straight-Arm_Pulldown.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, holding the bar with an overhand grip.
Step back and lean forward slightly from your hips, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly back to about head height.
Keep your elbows only slightly bent and don't bend them to pull.

Sumo_Deadlift.name: Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grip the bar with your hands inside your legs, arms straight.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and push your knees out over your toes.
Push the floor away and stand up tall, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lower the bar the same way with a flat back.

T-Bar_Row_with_Handle.name: T-Bar Row
steps: Set one end of a barbell in a landmine or a corner, put plates on the other end and straddle the bar facing the plates.
Place a close-grip handle under the bar next to the plates and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward with a flat back, arms straight.
Pull the plates up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
Keep your back flat and your upper body still throughout.

Thigh_Abductor.name: Machine Hip Abduction
steps: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and the pads on the outside of your knees.
Hold the handles and start with your legs together.
Push your knees out to the sides as far as you comfortably can.
Let them come back together slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and control the return.

Thigh_Adductor.name: Machine Hip Adduction
steps: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and the pads on the inside of your knees.
Set the start position so your legs are open to a comfortable stretch.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet.
Let them open slowly back to the start.
Keep your back against the pad and don't let the weight pull your legs open quickly.

Trap_Bar_Deadlift.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
steps: Stand in the middle of a trap bar with your feet hip-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to hold the handles at your sides, arms straight.
Flatten your back, brace your stomach and lift your chest.
Push through your feet to stand up tall.
Lower the bar to the floor the same way, keeping your back flat.

Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
steps: Place one knee and the same hand on a bench, back flat, holding a dumbbell in your other hand.
Lift that upper arm until it's in line with your body, elbow bent and forearm hanging down.
Straighten your arm behind you until it's fully straight.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to the start, then switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper arm still; only your forearm should move.

Triceps_Overhead_Extension_with_Rope.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a pulley and stand facing away from it, holding the ends above and behind your head.
Step forward into a staggered stance and lean forward slightly, elbows bent and pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to push the rope forward and up until your arms are straight.
Let your hands return slowly behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still beside your head.

Triceps_Pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley and hold it with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall facing the machine with your elbows tucked against your sides.
Straighten your arms to push the bar down to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about level with the floor.
Keep your elbows still at your sides and don't lean over the bar.

Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment.name: Triceps Pushdown, Rope
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold the ends with your palms facing each other.
Stand tall facing the machine with your elbows tucked against your sides.
Straighten your arms to push the rope down, separating the ends at the bottom.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about level with the floor.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.

Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Military_Press.name: Double Kettlebell Press
steps: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your shoulders, handles in your palms and the bells against your forearms.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and brace your stomach.
Press both kettlebells up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes so you don't lean back.

Underhand_Cable_Pulldowns.name: Lat Pulldown, Underhand
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, bringing your elbows down towards your ribs.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing back to pull.

Upright_Barbell_Row.name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar up along the front of your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows are at about shoulder height and the bar is at your lower chest.
Lower it slowly back to your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body and stop lower if your shoulders feel pinched.

V-Bar_Pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown, V-Bar
steps: Attach a close-grip handle to the lat pulldown cable and sit with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the handle with your palms facing each other, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and pull the handle to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing back to pull.

Weighted_Pull_Ups.name: Weighted Pull-Up
steps: Attach a plate to a dipping belt around your hips, or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold a pull-up bar with your palms facing away, hands slightly wider than your shoulders, and hang with straight arms.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Only add weight once you can do strict pull-ups easily, and don't swing.

Wide-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.name: Barbell Bench Press, Wide Grip
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands clearly wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together, and use a spotter or safety arms.

Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown, Wide Grip
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away, hands wider than your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing your body to pull the bar down.

Zottman_Curl.name: Zottman Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
At the top, turn your palms to face down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with your palms facing down, then turn them back up at the bottom.
Keep your elbows by your sides throughout.
